According to the reference sources, all of the constructors appear to throw for a null encoding value in .NET Framework. I suppose this might just be a case where the behavior changed in .NET Core and some of the overloads got missed when updating the docs.

The behavior was changed in <https://github.com/dotnet/coreclr/pull/24056> to fix <https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/issues/17157>.  Before that, the StreamReader and StreamWriter constructors would have thrown ArgumentNullException if `encoding == null`.  <https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/issues/2376> is also related.
